description: Top hotels in a city from Agoda's city guide page (no dates needed): about 10 properties with Agoda hotel ID, name, star rating, area, amenities (Wi-Fi, parking, breakfast, pool …), review score out of 10 with its label and number of reviews, a recent guest quote, average price per night with currency, and the Agoda hotel link. The city is Agoda's URL slug, e.g. bangkok-th, tokyo-jp, bali-id, london-gb. Related tools on this server, for a different need: travel_hostelworld when you need Hostels in a city as listed on Hostelworld's public city; travel_kayak when you need KAYAK flight route overview between two city or airport. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
